newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 87,750 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 41.653 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in the U.K. received 37,000 tonnes, in France 35,250, in Denmark 10,000, in Germany 3,000 and in Belgium 2,500 tonnes, it added.

This week's award brings the cumulative tonnage awarded for export from the 1996/97 crop to 2.186 million tonnes. This compares with the 49,500 tonnes awarded on June 5, 1996, when the cumulative tonnage totalled 2.262 million tonnes.
Last week the EU awarded 64,275 tonnes of white sugar at a maximum export rebate of 42.874 Ecus.
